content:
A Partner Development Manager (PDM) at AWS works within the AWS Partner Organization to build and grow business through third‑party partners (ISVs, SIs/consultancies, distributors, MSPs). The role blends business development, program management, and sales orchestration.

What it involves
- Portfolio ownership: Identify, recruit, and onboard partners; assess fit (industry, workloads, maturity), and prioritize a portfolio for growth.
- Joint business planning: Create and execute joint go-to-market plans with partners (targets, use cases, territories, industries), including enablement, marketing, and co-selling motions.
- Pipeline and co-sell: Map accounts, generate opportunities, drive AWS co-sell through ACE/CRM, coordinate with AWS account teams and partner sales to progress deals and remove blockers.
- Enablement: Help partners achieve APN tiering, Competencies, Service Delivery validations, certifications; guide solution architecture alignment and well-architected practices.
- Programs and funding: Leverage AWS programs (MAP, MDF, Proof-of-Concept funding, credits), AWS Marketplace listings, and incentives to accelerate adoption.
- GTM and marketing: Plan campaigns, events, and content with AWS and partner marketing; measure ROI and iterate.
- Operational rigor: Forecasting, QBRs, scorecards, and data-driven performance reviews; maintain hygiene in ACE/CRM and Partner Central.
- Stakeholder management: Align with AWS field sales, solution architects, service teams, industry teams, and partner execs; manage escalations and executive briefings.
- Territory/segment focus: Roles may specialize (ISV vs SI/MSP, industry verticals, SMB/mid-market/enterprise, or geographies).

Key metrics (vary by team)
- Co-sell wins and influenced revenue
- New workloads/migrations to AWS, consumption growth (e.g., EC2, EKS, serverless, data/AI)
- Pipeline creation and progression velocity
- Partner certifications, competencies/validations achieved
- Marketplace GMV, MAP/MDF utilization and ROI
- Customer references and repeatable solutions

Skills and experience
- Partner/channel or business development background; understanding of cloud economics and SaaS/consulting models
- Strong program and project management; data-driven forecasting
- Executive communication and negotiation; ability to influence without authority
- Familiarity with AWS services, migration/modernization, data/AI, and industry use cases
- Comfort with CRM tools (Salesforce/ACE), Marketplace, and partner program mechanics

Day-to-day snapshot
- Morning pipeline sync with AWS account teams; review ACE opportunities and blockers
- Partner QBR to assess goals, certifications, and GTM campaigns
- Work with a partner SA on a validation/competency or solution design for a co-sell
- Submit MDF request and plan a joint webinar or event
- Exec call with an ISV to finalize Marketplace private offer terms
- Update forecasts/scorecards; prep internal readouts for leadership

Career path
- Progression to Senior/Principal PDM, Partner Sales Manager, Alliances/Channels leadership, or broader biz dev roles; some move into product GTM or industry roles.

Note: The exact scope varies by org (ISV vs SI, industry, segment) and country, but the core mandate is to accelerate customer outcomes and AWS consumption through a healthy, scalable partner ecosystem.
